description: This file implements a ConnectionManager class for resiliently managing connections to the AgentField server, including automatic reconnection, health monitoring, and degraded mode handling.

classes.name: ConnectionState
classes.description: Enumeration of possible connection states for the AgentField server connectivity.

classes.name: ConnectionConfig
classes.description: Dataclass holding configuration parameters for connection retries and health checks.

classes.name: ConnectionManager
classes.description: Class managing resilient connections to the AgentField server, including reconnection logic and health monitoring.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the connection manager and attempts the first connection, starting health checks or reconnection loops based on success.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the connection manager and cancels ongoing tasks.

methods.name: _attempt_connection
methods.description: Attempts to establish a connection to the AgentField server.

methods.name: _health_check_loop
methods.description: Continuously monitors connection health via heartbeat and triggers reconnection if needed.

methods.name: _reconnection_loop
methods.description: Attempts to reconnect to the server with retries until successful or shutdown.

methods.name: _on_connection_failure
methods.description: Handles actions upon connection failure, including switching to degraded mode.

methods.name: is_connected
methods.description: Checks if the current connection state is connected.

methods.name: is_degraded
methods.description: Checks if the system is running in degraded mode.
